scope: store::commit/prune only to establish state canonicalization contract

must_fix.finding: Store::commit prunes its owned State clone, while Runtime::persist installs the original unpruned next. Disk and runtime state diverge after retention is exercised. Runtime queries/dedup can retain expired records and repeatedly exceed bounds despite discardable terminals.
must_fix.minimal_fix: Commit one canonical pruned state and install exactly that committed state; prefer commit returns Store.state clone or preflight prune+validate once.
must_fix.regression: Exercise more than 128 terminal sessions/jobs and 256 requests; runtime state, committed disk and reloaded state must be identical and remain usable.

must_fix.finding: All commit errors mark healthy=false, including pre-write state validation/encoded capacity refusal. A rejected admission can permanently prevent valid cleanup Finish facts from being committed, even when the filesystem is healthy.
must_fix.minimal_fix: Bounded canonical preflight before admitting new work, reserve terminal recording capacity, and distinguish safe admission rejection from uncertain write failure. Do not weaken poison after actual I/O uncertainty.
must_fix.regression: At the admission bound refuse new work while an already admitted owner can still persist actual verified cleanup.

reported_related_store_issue.finding: Independent jobs pruning may remove a Finished job that still has retained child sessions; State::validate then rejects the orphan. Example: oldest completed job has one verified child, followed by 128 completed zero-child jobs.

recovery_boundaries.finding: Only previous-instance sessions are queried. A same-instance ended job with Unconfirmed typed close cannot consume an already retained exact helper terminal until agent restart.
recovery_boundaries.suggestion: Query only absent-owner/unconfirmed current jobs as well, preserving exact kind/correlation/device/UID/resource checks; otherwise document restart requirement.

recovery_boundaries.finding: A durable Starting job killed before any Begin has no sessions/attempts to query, and remains Recovering forever, blocking its fixed profile.
recovery_boundaries.suggestion: Define a narrow no-resource-intent criterion justified by the invariant that Begin must durably precede any helper request, or expose explicit safe administrator coordination; never infer arbitrary hardware restoration.

verified_alignment: Root manifest selects immutable profiles/configs, RPC carries no endpoint/path/credentials
Actual TLS principal/key comes from runner, session Begin precedes admit/helper prepare
Connected accepted only with role-specific receipt evidence
Finish cannot declare NotStarted after a durable helper attempt
Rust export single-stop is explicitly Unsupported in the Controls fast path; per-incoming stop remains independent
Actual cleanup is awaited by jobs after operation/report errors, and soft backend deadline without cleanup Some is nonterminal
Recovery proof checks kind/correlation/device/owner UID and optional exact helper resource ID; Unknown is not success
limits: Static source review, not new execution evidence
Root is compiling/modifying owned code concurrently; hashes identify reviewed snapshot rather than a final freeze
No claim of complete shared foreground extraction, heartbeat/RTT, hardware acceptance or crash FD revocation
